entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just need a return label.
I can certainly help you get that started. First, to make sure I'm looking at the right account, can I get your full name? And just to clarify, what specifically is the issue with the band?
The name is Alex Chen. Look, there's no issue. It was an impulse buy, I changed my mind, and I just don't use it. Simple as that. Can I return it or not?
Okay, Alex. Thank you for that information. I understand. Let me just pull up your order details and review the policy. One moment, please.
Alright, I see your order here. It was delivered on December 22nd. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process this return for you.
Great. So you're emailing me the label?

Yes, I've just sent the prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
